cat >> backend/tests/api/routes/test_items.py <<'EOF'


def test_clear_item_description_owner(
    client: TestClient, normal_user_token_headers: dict[str, str]
) -> None:
    create_response = client.post(
        f"{settings.API_V1_STR}/items/",
        headers=normal_user_token_headers,
        json={"title": "Foo", "description": "Fighters"},
    )
    item_id = create_response.json()["id"]
    response = client.delete(
        f"{settings.API_V1_STR}/items/{item_id}/description",
        headers=normal_user_token_headers,
    )
    assert response.status_code == 200
    content = response.json()
    assert content["id"] == item_id
    assert content["title"] == "Foo"
    assert content["description"] is None


def test_clear_item_description_superuser(
    client: TestClient, superuser_token_headers: dict[str, str], db: Session
) -> None:
    item = create_random_item(db)
    response = client.delete(
        f"{settings.API_V1_STR}/items/{item.id}/description",
        headers=superuser_token_headers,
    )
    assert response.status_code == 200
    content = response.json()
    assert content["id"] == str(item.id)
    assert content["title"] == item.title
    assert content["description"] is None


def test_clear_item_description_not_found(
    client: TestClient, superuser_token_headers: dict[str, str]
) -> None:
    response = client.delete(
        f"{settings.API_V1_STR}/items/{uuid.uuid4()}/description",
        headers=superuser_token_headers,
    )
    assert response.status_code == 404
    content = response.json()
    assert content["detail"] == "Item not found"


def test_clear_item_description_not_enough_permissions(
    client: TestClient, normal_user_token_headers: dict[str, str], db: Session
) -> None:
    item = create_random_item(db)
    response = client.delete(
        f"{settings.API_V1_STR}/items/{item.id}/description",
        headers=normal_user_token_headers,
    )
    assert response.status_code == 403
    content = response.json()
    assert content["detail"] == "Not enough permissions"
EOF

I added `DELETE /api/v1/items/{id}/description`. It clears the description and returns the updated item. Owners and superusers can call it, and other users get 403. I did not run the tests or the app, as you asked.

The changes are in three files:

- **`backend/app/api/routes/items.py`**: the new `clear_item_description` handler. It returns 404 for a missing item and 403 for a non-owner, with the same messages as the other item endpoints.
- **`backend/app/crud.py`**: `get_item` and `clear_item_description`. The lint hook flagged the route for calling the session directly, and `backend/app/CLAUDE.md` requires database access to go through `crud.py`, so the queries moved there.
- **`backend/tests/api/routes/test_items.py`**: four tests covering the owner, superuser, not-found and not-enough-permissions cases.

Things to know:

- **Frontend client not regenerated.** `docs/api.md` asks for `scripts/generate-client.sh` after endpoint changes. That script imports the backend app and runs `bun`, which is running the app, so I skipped it. Run it before the frontend needs the new operation.
- **Existing handlers left alone.** The lint hook also flags the existing item and user routes for direct session access and numeric status codes. I only fixed my new code, so the rule still fails on the older handlers if it is applied to the whole file.
- **Nothing committed.** The working tree has three modified files.
